up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity records with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1795192 (Cyclin-dependent kinase 13). Return the following columns: assay CHEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), organism tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule CHEMBL ID (compound_dictionary.molecule_chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Include only records where the standard relation is exactly '=', the pChEMBL value is not null, and the target is a human single-protein target (target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606). Filter assays to those whose assay_type is one of the valid assay types (A, B, F, P, T, U) and the assay_organism is 'Homo sapiens' (target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens' or assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' as appropriate for single-protein targets). Order the results by molecule_chembl_id ascending, then by assay_chembl_id ascending. Do not include any additional filtering on documentation type, confidence score, or standard units. Do not apply any row limit beyond what the user explicitly requested (the first 1000 rows).
sql:
WITH tgt AS (
  SELECT tid
  FROM target_dictionary
  WHERE target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND tax_id = 9606 AND chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795192'
),
assays_human AS (
  SELECT assay_id
  FROM assays
  JOIN tgt ON assays.tid = tgt.tid
  WHERE assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN assays ass2 ON a.assay_id = ass2.assay_id
JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = ass2.assay_id
WHERE
  a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.activity_id IN (
    SELECT activity_id
    FROM activities
    WHERE standard_relation = '='
      AND pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
      AND molregno IN (
        SELECT molregno
        FROM activities
        WHERE assay_id IN (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE tid IN (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND tax_id = 9606 AND chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795192'))
      )
  )
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
